items.title: Planned family visa crackdown labelled 'human rights issue'
items.description: Experts are divided on the government's plan to increase its control over net migration figures, warning the devil is in the detail.

items.title: Australians cut ties with servos as EV record sales continue
items.description: Over the past year, electric car sales have tripled, as anxiety about fuel shortages and rising petrol prices continues.

items.title: 'Needs a Valium': Brother of former NSW premier fronts corruption inquiry
items.description: The brother of former NSW premier Dominic Perrottet says he undertook factional work while on the clock for another MP in his first appearance before a corruption inquiry.

items.title: 'Gone down like a lead balloon': Ex-FA boss on FIFA's World Cup backflip
items.description: David Gallop was Football Australia CEO when Gianni Infantino took over the FIFA presidency from the corruption-stained run of Sepp Blatter, he says Infantino's World Cup proposal stank.

items.title: Hip hop artist-turned-novelist wins Miles Franklin award
items.description: Malaysian Australian author Omar Musa has taken out the Miles Franklin Literary Award with his second novel, Fierceland, set between Malaysian Borneo and Sydney.

items.title: Reformed neo-Nazi tells royal commission he was sold a 'load of lies'
items.description: A reformed neo-Nazi cut ties with his extremist organisation after he realised he was being sold a "load of lies", the antisemitism royal commission has heard.

items.title: Netanyahu is running out of options on Gaza. None really work for him
items.description: US President Donald Trump wants Israel to do a deal with Hamas now, but conservatives in Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet don't want a deal with the group ever — and it's leaving the Israeli prime minister in a difficult position.

items.title: 'List of doom' outlines birds facing extinction if deadly flu spreads
items.description: A list of thousands of Australian species have been ranked by threat level as the deadly H5 bird flu spreads.

items.title: Top designers recognised at 2026 National Indigenous Fashion Awards
items.description: A unique partnership between a remote Northern Territory women's centre and an art studio in India has been recognised at in this year's prestigious National Indigenous Fashion Awards.

items.title: Corruption probe into Andrews-era firefighters negotiations handed down
items.description: The IBAC report into a bitter pay dispute between the Victorian government and firefighters during the Andrews era found United Firefighters Union boss Peter Marshall had privileged access to government figures, but stopped short of any finding of corrupt conduct.

items.title: Police confirm 'no surviving occupants' after ute, car engulfed in flames
items.description: Authorities say the crash on the Stuart Highway, near Marrakai, claimed the lives of everyone involved, and "appears to have been a high-speed head-on collision", with both vehicles catching fire.

items.title: The Danube river is so low that Nazi warships are emerging
items.description: Europe's second-longest river is carrying less water than it has in decades, revealing shipwrecks and shutting down nuclear reactors.

items.title: Brutal killing of Chinese dog and her pups sparks outrage
items.description: Protesters around the world are calling for justice for a Chinese stray dog and her puppies after they were beaten to death and set alight by a group of boys in China.

items.title: When this photo was posted online the racist commentary began
items.description: A national inquiry into racism, hate and violence towards First Nations people has come to Hobart to hear from the state's Aboriginal groups and people with lived experience of racism.

items.title: Piece of SpaceX rocket believed to have crashed into Moon
items.description: Part of a SpaceX rocket has crashed into the Moon, with the impact likely to be seen from Earth.

items.title: These 10 Aussie wildflowers have superpowers. Pick your favourite
items.description: Move over waratahs and banksias! These 10 flowers from the unsung understorey are not just pretty faces, they have surprising tricks up their sleeves.

items.title: 'A lifelong wound': What happens when kids are parentified
items.description: Eve was an adult when she realised she grew up in a home where the child-adult relationships were reversed.

items.title: Princess Eugenie gives birth to third child
items.description: Britain's Princess Eugenie has given birth to a baby girl, her third child and first daughter.

items.title: Mandatory domestic roaming to be key focus of mobile coverage inquiry
items.description: Consumer and regional advocates are urging the government to intervene and mandate domestic roaming now, arguing the ACCC's 12-month inquiry will take too long.

items.title: Labor MP Luke Gosling set to be prosecuted for assault by Commonwealth DPP
items.description: The Commonwealth Director of Public Prosecutions is set to take over the case against Federal Labor MP Luke Gosling, to avoid a perceived conflict of interest within the Northern Territory Director of Public Prosecutions.

items.title: Indigenous culture and AI
items.description: What happens when the world's oldest continuous cultures come up against one of the newest technologies: artificial intelligence? There are growing concerns about AI systems being trained on Indigenous artworks, language and cultural material. There are also questions about who's generating this content, and who benefits from its proliferation. For some it's innovation, for others it's cultural appropriation.

items.title: Jetstar to scrap free 7kg carry-on for new overhead luggage fees
items.description: Jetstar has announced it will charge passengers to stow carry-on luggage in overhead lockers from next year, allowing only a small under-seat bag at no extra cost.

items.title: Police seek to solve a decades-old mystery of man's body found in car
items.description: NSW Police are still trying to solve the case of a man whose body was found in a car with WA number plates from a vehicle written off years earlier.

items.title: NAPLAN results are out. Here's what they mean
items.description: NAPLAN results have arrived for students across Australia, giving parents a snapshot of how their child is tracking in literacy and numeracy. But what do the scores really mean and when should parents be concerned?

items.title: Court clears way for sexual harassment complaint against ex-NT judge
items.description: The Federal Court has ruled sexual harassment allegations against a former NT Supreme Court judge can proceed, rejecting an argument that too much time had passed since the alleged conduct more than a decade ago.
